thesis: CDNA is a rich-valuation, high-beta name being bought into a confirmed risk-off tape, after a gap-up spike that has already started to unwind on elevated volume. The quality is real, but forward P/E of 49.77 and P/S of 8.30 leave little room, the headline profit margin is flattered by an outlier quarter, and sequential revenue growth is decelerating. Reward/risk of about 1.4 to the 52-week high is thin for a stock with ATR of 6.85% of price and beta 2.49 while QQQ is below both its 50- and 200-day averages. News and SEC filings were not checked this run, so offering and event risk are unassessed, which is missing information and not a finding of danger, but it argues against sizing up.
